en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Bukeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Rewards of the Believer when his child dies, is the Paradise, whether he is patient or is not patient’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan all from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the reward for a believing person for the death of his sons is paradise, whether he exercise patience or not.”
